scoring_geometry.distance_definition: Euclidean distance in millimeters from target center to pellet-hole center.
scoring_geometry.calculation: For d_mm <= 25.0, score_tenths = min(109, floor((11.0 - d_mm / 2.5) * 10 + epsilon)). For d_mm > 25.0, score_tenths = 0.

boundary_policy.epsilon_scope: Floating-point protection for exact mathematical decimal-zone boundaries only; it does not extend the physical maximum valid radius.
boundary_policy.conceptual_rule: Every additional 0.25 mm of center distance lowers the score by exactly 0.1 point.
